name: Boston Scientific
description: Boston Scientific makes less-invasive medical devices used by heart, digestive, urinary, nerve and vascular specialists, and sells them to hospitals and clinics. Two segments: Cardiovascular (66 percent of 2025 sales: ablation catheters for atrial fibrillation, WATCHMAN stroke-prevention implants, pacemakers and defibrillators, stents and balloons, cancer embolization) and MedSurg (34 percent: endoscopy, urology, neuromodulation). Revenue is one-time per procedure or per implant, with disposable catheters recurring with procedure volume. Growth in 2025 (net sales up 19.9 percent) was led by the Farapulse pulsed field ablation system and WATCHMAN.

businessLines.name: Cardiovascular
businessLines.how: Sells catheters, implants and disposables to hospitals and cardiac labs, mostly one-time per procedure; ablation catheters and WATCHMAN devices are bought per case, so revenue follows procedure volume.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment operating income (before corporate costs, amortisation, impairments and restructuring)

businessLines.name: MedSurg
businessLines.how: Sells endoscopy, urology and neuromodulation devices and disposables to hospitals, surgery centres and clinics; per-procedure disposables plus implanted devices (sacral and spinal neuromodulation).

brands.note: Definitive agreement to acquire 100 percent at $374 per share, about $14.5 billion; not yet owned.
